gen-righteous-gf-rambla: Rambla keeps its small letters rising almost to the capitals' height, giving text a compact, clean look. Rambla also sits beside Righteous, whose bent-rod letters never vary in stroke, so the two feel like friendly opposites.
gen-righteous-gf-recursive: Loud, playful lettering: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line. Recursive carries paragraphs with strokes that hold their thickness in every direction, an approachable, modern sans-serif that never tires the eye.
gen-righteous-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Righteous is commanding and fun, its bowls filling the line like thin steel rod bent into letters. Sofia Sans Condensed has a large x-height, tight ascender room and no calligraphic shading, so give it a little extra size.
gen-righteous-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters, with lowercase nearly matching the capitals and strokes of uniform weight. And across a full page it would feel precise and technical, a steady hum beneath Righteous.
gen-righteous-gf-tiny5: Thin steel rod bent into every letter: that is Righteous, with no hairlines. The strongest thing here is the clash between that unbroken line and Tiny5, an approachable sans with short-looking ascenders.
gen-righteous-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu reads modern and professional, with a lofty lowercase band. But beside Righteous, whose letters look bent from a single length of wire, it feels like a hushed room after a fanfare.
gen-righteous-gf-viga: Righteous bends thin steel rod into commanding, fun letters whose bowls fill the line. And Viga, whose strokes are hairline-free and whose capitals barely rise above the lowercase, can take a slightly larger size.
gen-righteous-gf-voces: One unmodulated line runs through every Righteous glyph, as if bent from thin steel rod. Voces, with a modest contrast like lightly engraved brass lettering, would move through paragraphs with a steady, professional feel.
gen-righteous-gf-winky-rough: Traced as if with one marker tip, Righteous leads, while Winky Rough keeps its body height nearly level with the capitals. Righteous belongs up top, in large, brief lines of text.
gen-righteous-gf-yantramanav: Righteous draws its g in one unchanging line weight, with bowls that fill the line. Yantramanav, a sans with spacious terminal gaps and lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, can sit at a smaller size.
